name: tdd-bdd-agent
description: TDD/BDD agent — implements kata features using strict RED-GREEN-REFACTOR discipline, one test at a time

action.command: log=/tmp/cqrs-booking-tdd-hook.log; date -Is > "$log"; docker run --rm -v "$(pwd):/app" -w /app kata-tests pytest tests/ -v --tb=short >> "$log" 2>&1; result=$?; printf "\nExit code: %s\n" "$result" >> "$log"; cat "$log"; exit "$result"
